sections.name: Hansen
sections.text:
Solute transport using convection-dispersion.
   Used by movement vertical matrix solute (see 56.3, page 308) .

sections.name: Mollerup
sections.desc: Coupled vertical and horizontal transport. See Mollerup 2007 for details.
sections.sig:
< Mollerup (solver solver )                                     ; Default cxsparse value.
                  (debug 0)
                  (stabilizing method Timestep reduction)
                  (enable boundary diffusion true)
                  (upstream weight 1 [<fraction>]) >

attrs.name: solver
attrs.doc: Model used for solving matrix equation system.

attrs.name: debug
attrs.doc:
Enable additional debug message. A value of 0 means no message, higher
     numbers means more messages.

attrs.name: stabilizing method
attrs.doc:
Method used for stabilizing results. Must be one of these:
     None: No stabilizing method applied
     Timestep reduction: Reduce timesteps.
     Streamline diffusion: Increase diffusion.

attrs.name: enable boundary diffusion
attrs.doc: If this is set, diffusion over boundaries is enabled.

attrs.name: upstream weight
attrs.doc: Upstream weighting factor: 1 = full upstream formulation, 0.5 = equal weight.

sections.text:
Coupled vertical and horizontal transport. See Mollerup 2007 for details.
   Used by movement rectangle matrix solute (see 56.2, page 307) .
  < Mollerup (solver solver )                                     ; Default cxsparse value.
                  (debug 0)
                  (stabilizing method Timestep reduction)
                  (enable boundary diffusion true)
                  (upstream weight 1 [<fraction>]) >
    solver : solver component (see chapter 82)
     Component (default ‘cxsparse’)
     Model used for solving matrix equation system.
    debug: integer
     Parameter (default 0)
     Enable additional debug message. A value of 0 means no message, higher
     numbers means more messages.
    stabilizing method : string (see section 4.1.5)
     Optional parameter (default ‘Timestep reduction’)
     Method used for stabilizing results. Must be one of these:
     None: No stabilizing method applied
     Timestep reduction: Reduce timesteps.
     Streamline diffusion: Increase diffusion.
    enable boundary diffusion: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default true)
     If this is set, diffusion over boundaries is enabled.
    upstream weight: number [<fraction>]
     Parameter (default 1)
     Upstream weighting factor: 1 = full upstream formulation, 0.5 = equal weight.

sections.name: convection
sections.desc:
Pure forward calculation of flow except through upper boundary. J[edge] = q[edge]
* C old[upstream]
sections.used: movement vertical matrix solute (see 56.3, page 308) , and movement rectangle matrix solute (see 56.2, page 307) .
